verdict.rationale: Devin has a documented public API, so a downloadable spec is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows an OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt index is LLM-oriented documentation, not a machine-readable API spec, so it is only adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
